name: English speech -> Hindi speech (Deepgram STT -> Sarvam translate -> ElevenLabs TTS)
_comment: A multi-vendor voice DAG: transcribe English speech (Deepgram), translate EN->HI with an LLM (Sarvam, OpenAI-compatible chat), and synthesize Hindi speech (ElevenLabs multilingual). Credentials are injected from the environment via ${ENV_VAR} — NEVER hardcode keys. Provider nodes read api_key from their `config` blob; the llm node from its typed `api_key` field. Sarvam-30b is a reasoning model, so max_tokens must be generous (>=4000) or it returns null content. Live-validated end-to-end by tests/dag_multivendor_live_e2e.rs. For gateway WS delivery, append an `audio_output` node after `tts`.

nodes.system_prompt: You are a translation engine. Translate the user's English text into Hindi in Devanagari script. Output ONLY the Hindi translation - no English, no transliteration, no notes.
